title: Frontend Developer
project_desc: At Qarhami, a Houston-based car rental company, I worked as a Frontend Developer where I developed the company’s web application from scratch, transforming Figma UI designs into pixel-perfect, responsive interfaces using React.js and modern frontend technologies. I was responsible for implementing real-time vehicle tracking through Google Maps API, allowing users to monitor rental cars live on the map. This role enhanced my expertise in building scalable and high-performance web applications while deepening my experience with geolocation features and modern JavaScript development practices.
